aggregate_model_ranking: not_performed; acquisition geometry and weak-reference limits preclude model selection
spatial_dependence: 5km block summaries are descriptive variability only; no pixel-independent confidence intervals computed
limitations: Optical weak references are not human truth or field validation.
Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 acquisition times differ; report each exact temporal offset.
Ascending and descending Sentinel-1 geometries are assessed separately per acquisition and never pooled as a common temporal series.
The 20m grid is the native Sentinel-2 B11 grid; Sentinel-1 probabilities use area-mean aggregation from 10m with all source cells valid.
Regional footprint is provisional and cannot support village-specific statistics or impact-area claims.
No confirmed flooding, embankment failure, crop impact, fish loss or causality is inferred.
